# Windy

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 15 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A dark weather map: charcoal right rail, white search pill, red primary button, orange selected forecast chip.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (login asks for email and password plus Google, Apple, and Facebook; nothing was entered). Themes: light, dark.

Windy is a public wind and weather map at [windy.com](https://www.windy.com/). This package records the signed-out map, the menu, search, a place detail strip, the empty favorites and alerts panes, the plugin list, the uploader, and the empty login and register popups. Refreshed on 2026-11-21 from product build `51.4.4.ind.c444`, signed out, no account. Headless Playwright at 1440 by 900 and 390 by 844, device pixel ratio 2. No session was present. Login and register were opened only far enough to see the empty fields, then that branch stopped.

The product declares `color-scheme: light only` on `:root` and rebinds the same colour names under `.dark-content`. The map chrome, the menu, and the login popup all carry `dark-content`. There is no light theme of the map.

## Typography

8 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: -apple-system, Arial, bariolnumbers.

### Fonts (from README.md)

The UI face is the system stack: `-apple-system, system-ui, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif`. Body size is 14px, weight 400.

Bariol Medium (`bariolnumbers`, `bariolmedium`) is loaded from `https://www.windy.com/img/bariol/` as woff2 and otf. It is used for the big temperature. It is proprietary and is not committed. The token falls back to Arial, which is also what `#submitLogin` computed to.

`iconfont` is Windy's own icon font, referenced as a relative `iconfont.woff2` from the CSS bundle. The glyphs are private. They are not extracted. Leaflet zoom controls use Lucida Console, Monaco, monospace at 18px weight 700, and that control was `display` with zero size on this desktop layout (the bottom-bar zoom is the one on screen).

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The root's computed custom properties are the light bindings. The map you see is dark. Use the `dark` set for the map, menu, and login, and the `light` set for the detail table (`bg-white`) and any pane that does not carry `dark-content`.

Selected chips on the bottom bar paint orange (`#d49500`). The shared `.switch__item.selected` rule paints `var(--color-ui-primary)`, which is red (`#9d0300`). Both are recorded. The live bottom bar is the orange one.

Login field radius was `3.6px` in computed style (`0.2em` at 18px). It is stored as `3.6px`, not rounded.

The Google provider row reported `color: rgb(236, 236, 236)` on a white button. That is the popup's inherited colour. The label the button actually draws is the provider's own. It is not in the token file.

Bariol is a commercial face used for the big temperature. It is not in this package. The tokens name the family and fall back to Arial.

Map colours (the wind overlay, the particle field, the temperature raster) are drawn on a canvas. They are not CSS tokens and are not in `tokens.json`.

Screenshots are 256-colour PNGs. Read colours from the tokens, not from the images. The 2026-11-21 shots are a fresh load of the public page. The map query string is the client camera, so it is not stored in the package. The startup card on the default map named a place the product picked. That label is the product's own overlay, not an account.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the dark chrome on the map.** The menu, the login popup, and the right rail sit on `#3c3c3c` with cream text `#ececec` and cream-yellow secondary `#fff3e1`. See [screenshots/map-dark-default.png](screenshots/map-dark-default.png).
- **Keep the one red.** Primary buttons, the menu icon, the detail footer, and the close control use `#9d0300`. Do not recolour them to the orange of the model chips. See [screenshots/login-dark-empty.png](screenshots/login-dark-empty.png).
- **Use orange for the selected forecast chip and Premium.** `#d49500` is the selected model chip, the hour marker, and Go Premium. See [components/crops/chip-selected.png](components/crops/chip-selected.png).
- **Put the big temperature in Bariol, with Arial as the fallback.** The desktop "now" figure is 67px `bariolnumbers`. The rest of the UI is the system sans at 14px. See [screenshots/map-dark-default.png](screenshots/map-dark-default.png).
- **Give search a white pill and the login fields a charcoal field.** Search is a 33px white pill, radius 18px, shadow `0 0 4px #000`. Login fields are `#4d4d4d` on the charcoal popup, radius 3.6px. See [screenshots/search-dark-results.png](screenshots/search-dark-results.png).
- **Do not invent a light map theme.** The stylesheet sets `color-scheme: light only` and still paints the map dark. The light semantic set is the detail table and the unbound `:root` names. See [screenshots/detail-dark-place.png](screenshots/detail-dark-place.png).
- **Do not sample the wind overlay.** Those colours are a canvas, not tokens. See [screenshots/map-dark-default.png](screenshots/map-dark-default.png).
- **Do not ship the icon font or Bariol.** Both are the product's files. Use the system stack and Arial. See [icon.png](icon.png).
